def.brief: README alignment, owner-authorized: Versioning classifies dropping a supported Python or host version (a raised engines floor) as major — no bump now; the 3.11 floor's release is coordinated outside this repository. Limits says how record-path entries match (a trailing / is a directory and what it holds, any other entry that exact file, never a prefix and never a directory that took a declared file's name) and that worker children start with their own host identity and without the parent's session ids. Documentation only: checked by links, diff and git diff --check, not by the suite.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
